sources.author: Anthropic

sources.title: Getting a design system set up in Claude Design
sources.author: Caviar / Alex Banaga
supportedClaims: Figma-owned foundations, Code connective work, browsable Design system and manual design decisions

sources.title: We imported a real client design system into Claude Design
sources.author: MarsBased / Anna Vidal
supportedClaims: Selected Figma input, product context, responsive instructions and direct refinement
sources.limitation: The tested handoff was a prompt. No verified Figma return in that run is not proof the route cannot exist.

sources.title: I built a 75-screen product with Claude Design + Claude Code
sources.author: GoodCode / Austin McDaniel
supportedClaims: Alternatives, connected flows, handoff and later refinement
sources.limitation: Reported speed does not prove production readiness. Do not carry the headline timing into the exercise.

sources.title: AI-assisted design system pilot
sources.author: Jérôme Benoit Reveau / Doctolib
supportedClaims: Explicit translation from prototype into production components and reviewed implementation
sources.limitation: One reported pilot. Exclude estimated percentage results and general success-rate claims.

claimMap.claim: Two starting routes feed the Design exploration loop; source ownership is distinct from the exploration tool.
Explore alternatives and select with reasons before connected-screen refinement.
Review the interactive prototype with people and export a recipient-usable handoff.
Continue in Figma as a chosen destination; inspect editability, native relationships and wiring separately.

The fresh Figma-first trial demonstrates import with typography metadata loss, operated alternatives, chat and comment refinement, an unsupported direct-save step with chat fallback, a connected prototype, and recipient-opened export.
